title: Nine Years and One Trunk
subtitle: 亲属与家人 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 亲属与家人（人与自我·家庭与亲情）
meta: 主题语境：亲属与家人（人与自我·家庭与亲情）　|　核心词汇：aunt　|　正文 327 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 aunt 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 an ① aunt came to stay for nine days and stayed for nine years, and my grandmother said that was how it happened. The ② aunt, meaning the person and not the relation, had one trunk and no explanations; an aunt, she said, is the only relative who arrives without being sent for. She said the trunk was the whole of her luggage and the whole of her argument.

Every ③ aunt in that family had a room that was not hers and a cupboard that was. Their ④ aunt with the trunk knew nine recipes and told nobody; an aunt, my father said, is the only person in a house who is family and guest at the same time. He said that is why there are two sets of rules.

My mother said ⑤ aunt was a word you gave to women who were not quite relations, and she said that was the useful part. The ⑥ aunt, meaning the word and not the woman, is the only title that can be earned by staying long enough; an aunt, she said, is what a family calls a woman it has not decided about. She said the deciding can take eleven years.

By 1961 the ⑦ aunt had taken over the kitchen and the Sunday, and nobody could say when. The ⑧ aunt they wrote to in March was a different woman entirely, in another country, with nine children; an aunt, my father said, is either the person who stayed or the person who did not, and the word covers both. He said the letters took nine days.

The ⑨ aunt I remember is the one with the trunk, who taught me nine words of another language and nothing else about herself. An ⑩ aunt, my mother said in 1971, is the only relation you can choose and still call a relation; every aunt, she said, is a stranger who has agreed to be counted. She said the counting is the whole of a family.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 姑母；姨母；婶母（一个人）
B. n. 姑母／姨母（指人本身，与亲戚关系相对）
C. n. 阿姨（指接管了厨房和星期天的那一位）
D. n. 姑母／姨母（指带着箱子来的那一位）
E. n. 阿姨（泛指称呼，并非亲属）
F. n. 阿姨（指这个称呼本身）
G. n. 姑母／姨母（指写信去的那一位）
H. n. 姑母／姨母（抽象总称；泛指）

items.q: an aunt came to stay for nine days
The aunt, meaning the person and not the relation
aunt was a word you gave to women
The aunt, meaning the word and not the woman
the aunt had taken over the kitchen
The aunt they wrote to in March
An aunt, my mother said in 1971

answers.why: aunt 意为“姑母、姨母”，1952 年有一位姨母来住九天，结果住了九年，祖母说事情就是这么发生的。
aunt 指“人本身”，与亲戚关系相对，那位姨母只有一只箱子，没有任何解释。
aunt 意为“姑母、姨母”，那一家里每一位姨母都有一间不是她的屋子和一个是她的柜子。
aunt 指带着箱子来的那一位，他们那位带着箱子的姨母会九种菜的做法，谁也不告诉。
aunt 为泛指称呼，并非亲属，母亲说“阿姨”是一个你送给那些不算亲戚的女人的称呼，她说这才是有用的部分。
aunt 指“这个称呼本身”，与那个女人相对，它是唯一可以靠待得够久就挣到的称呼。
aunt 指接管了厨房和星期天的那一位，到 1961 年那位姨母接管了厨房和星期天，谁也说不清是从什么时候开始的。
aunt 指写信去的那一位，他们三月写信去的那位姨母完全是另一个女人，在另一个国家，有九个孩子。
aunt 意为“姑母、姨母”，我记得的是带着箱子那一位，她教了我九个词的外语，关于她自己则什么也没说。
aunt 为抽象总称，母亲说姨母是唯一你可以自己选择、却仍然叫作亲戚的亲戚。
